source.snippet: I made a form for people to fill out and pay. Two people have signed up and paid. Neither entry is showing when i go to entries. I tried it myself. I collected the money, but does not show up on the entries list.

problem_statement: Small business owners using form-and-payment tools like Cognito Forms lose visibility into paid signups when payment is captured but the corresponding entry fails to appear, creating reconciliation gaps and potential fulfillment failures.
target_segment: Small business owners and solopreneurs using no-code form tools with integrated payments for signups or registrations
notes: Explicit money-on-the-line context: payments collected but entries missing. Business operator, not a hobbyist. Points to a broader gap: no lightweight payment-to-entry reconciliation monitoring for no-code form stacks. Opportunity: a monitoring/alerting layer that cross-checks payment processor records against form entry records and flags mismatches. Single signal; would need more instances to validate prevalence.
